title: Mu Chen vs Yang Hong
summary: The freshman assembly reaches its decisive fight: Yang Hong reveals he is already at the middle phase of Heavenly Fusion and vows to crush Mu Chen for the Spiritual Land. Mu Chen, still only at the late phase of Spirit, answers with spiritual formations: the Golden Wheel Spirit Cracking Formation, the Dragon Elephant Formation and, using a Level 2 formation as bait, the Level 3 Grand Flame Demon Formation, which shows he has also mastered the primary Heart Formation. Yang Hong summons the spirit of the Ancient Tiger Dragon, 50th on the Earth list of beasts, and Mu Chen replies with the Jiuyou Bird's spirit, stunning the watching seniors. Mu Chen then refuses to lean on Jiuyou and finishes the fight with the Great Buddha Art's black pagoda, leaving Yang Hong unconscious. Exhausted, Mu Chen hands the Spirit Flag to Luo Li; Mu Kui and another finalist give up too, so Luo Li is declared first among the freshmen without making a move. The next day Elder Zhu Tian leads the freshmen to the Spiritual Arts Divine Hall.
